question: How do I submit or report a complaint?
answer: You can submit a complaint using the Samvad-Setu mobile app or web portal by clicking Report Issue, uploading photos or videos, and describing the issue.

question: Can I upload photos or videos when submitting a complaint?
answer: Yes, you can attach photos, short videos, and GPS location coordinates directly to your complaint to help authorities identify and inspect the problem quickly.

question: Can I submit a complaint anonymously?
answer: Yes, Samvad-Setu allows citizens to report civic grievances anonymously, though providing a phone number helps you receive real-time SMS progress updates.

question: What languages can I use to file a grievance?
answer: You can submit complaints in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), or Hinglish. Our multilingual AI automatically processes and routes your grievance.

question: How can I check the status of my complaint?
answer: Go to Track Status on the portal or mobile app and enter your grievance ticket ID to see real-time progress and assigned department updates.

question: What do the different complaint status labels mean?
answer: Submitted means received, Under Review means initial triage, In Progress means a municipal field crew is dispatched, and Resolved means work is completed.

question: How long will it take for my complaint to be resolved?
answer: Standard civic complaints have a 24 to 72 hour SLA deadline. Structural and recurring problems are routed to the engineering and university R&D pipeline.

question: What should I do if my complaint is marked resolved but the work is incomplete?
answer: You can reopen the ticket within 7 days using the Reopen Complaint button on your dashboard and upload a photo showing the incomplete work.

question: How do I report a drinking water pipeline leakage?
answer: Select Water as the category or report drinking water pipe leak with your exact location. The Water Department will dispatch an emergency repair crew.

question: Who do I contact for contaminated or dirty tap water?
answer: Report contaminated water immediately on Samvad-Setu. Emergency safety protocols automatically escalate drinking water contamination to Critical priority.

question: What should I do if there is no water supply in my locality?
answer: Submit a grievance under Water Supply. Include your ward number, street name, and how many days water supply has been disrupted.

question: How do I request a municipal water tanker during a shortage?
answer: You can request an emergency municipal water tanker by filing a ticket under the Water Department or contacting the municipal water helpline.

question: How do I report a power outage or blackout in my area?
answer: Report a power cut under the Energy Department with your transformer code or street address for immediate feeder inspection.

question: What should I do if I see sparking wires or a snapped live wire?
answer: Snapped live wires trigger emergency safety escalation. Stay at least 10 meters away and report immediately on Samvad-Setu or call 112.

question: Who fixes broken or non-functioning street lights?
answer: Street light repairs are managed by the Energy and Urban Development Departments. Submit the pole number or nearby street landmark on Samvad-Setu.

question: How can I resolve faulty or inflated electricity meter bills?
answer: File a billing discrepancy grievance under the Energy Department along with a photo of your meter reading and latest electricity bill copy.

question: How do I report dangerous potholes on the main road?
answer: Take a picture of the pothole and upload it under the Urban Development or Public Works Department. GPS tags help road maintenance teams locate it.

question: Where do I report damaged footpaths or missing curb ramps?
answer: Report damaged sidewalks, curbs, or broken ramps under Accessibility and Urban Development for pedestrian maintenance.

question: Who fixes traffic signals that are malfunctioning or turned off?
answer: Traffic signal repairs are routed to Traffic Police and Municipal Electrical Division. Report the junction name and affected direction.

question: How do I complain about illegal road digging or open trenches left unattended?
answer: Report road excavation without safety barriers under Public Works Department (PWD). Contractors are penalized for leaving hazardous trenches open.

question: How do I complain about poor sanitation or doctor unavailability at a government health center?
answer: File a complaint under Healthcare or Health Department specifying the Primary Health Center (PHC) or Community Health Center (CHC) name.

question: What should I do if government hospital medicines are out of stock?
answer: Report medicine stockouts under the Health Department. The district civil surgeon office investigates supply chain gaps.

question: How do I report stray dog bites or animal menace?
answer: Submit a report under Health and Municipal Animal Control. Anti-rabies medical aid and animal birth control teams will be notified.

question: How can I request mosquito fogging in waterlogged neighborhoods?
answer: File a sanitation and vector-borne disease prevention request under the Health Department for malaria and dengue prevention.

question: How do I report infrastructure damage in a government school?
answer: Upload photos of damaged classrooms, leaking roofs, or broken boundary walls under the Education Department.

question: Who do I contact regarding non-functional toilets or drinking water in schools?
answer: Report school water and sanitation issues under Education. These are prioritized under the Swachh Vidyalaya municipal initiative.

question: Where can I register grievances regarding mid-day meal quality?
answer: Mid-day meal irregularities can be reported under the Education Department. District education officers conduct immediate spot inspections.

question: How do I check scholarship disbursement status for students?
answer: Grievances regarding state student scholarships should be submitted under Education or Welfare along with the application reference ID.

question: Who do I contact if the daily municipal garbage van does not arrive?
answer: File a missed collection grievance under Environment or Sanitation Department with your ward number and colony name.

question: How do I report an overflowing community dustbin or garbage dump?
answer: Take a photo of the overflowing dustbin and report under Environment. Sanitation trucks are dispatched within 24 hours.

question: Where do I complain about blocked sewage drains and foul odor?
answer: Report clogged open drains or overflowing sewer lines under Public Health Engineering (PHED) and Sanitation.

question: How do I report open burning of plastic and garbage?
answer: Waste burning produces toxic pollution. Report the exact location under the Environment Department for municipal inspection and fines.

question: How do I apply for an income, caste, or residential certificate?
answer: Certificate applications can be submitted online via the Jharkhand Jharsewa portal or at your local Pragya Kendra and CSC center.

question: Where do I complain about delays in issuing government certificates?
answer: If your certificate exceeds the Right to Service (RTS) timeline, lodge a grievance under Public Administration on Samvad-Setu.

question: How can seniors apply for or check the status of old age pensions?
answer: Pension applications and payment delay grievances are routed through Rural Livelihoods and Social Welfare Departments.

question: How do I update or link my Aadhaar card with municipal services?
answer: Visit the nearest municipal civic center or Aadhaar Seva Kendra. Inquiries can be submitted under Public Administration.

question: What happens after I submit a complaint on Samvad-Setu?
answer: Our AI classifies the category, checks for duplicates, assesses severity, and routes it to the designated department with an SLA timer.

question: How are emergency complaints handled differently?
answer: Emergency keywords like fire, collapse, or contamination trigger an immediate safety override to Critical severity and alert senior officials.

question: What is the R&D pipeline for structural civic problems?
answer: Recurring structural issues that routine repairs cannot fix are assigned to engineering universities for student research and CSR-funded prototypes.

question: Can I escalate a complaint if it is not resolved within the SLA?
answer: Yes, tickets exceeding the SLA are automatically escalated to the District Municipal Commissioner and relevant department head.

question: How do I report dangerous overgrown trees or fallen branches blocking roads?
answer: Report fallen trees or hazardous branches under Environment and Horticulture Department for immediate road clearance and pruning.

question: Where can I report illegal late-night loudspeaker or industrial noise pollution?
answer: Lodge a noise pollution complaint under Environment and Public Administration. Nighttime restrictions between 10 PM and 6 AM are strictly enforced.

question: How do I complain about dirty or unhygienic public community toilets?
answer: Report unhygienic community or public toilets under Sanitation and Urban Development with the facility location or landmark.

question: How do I request emergency ambulance services or report ambulance delays?
answer: Dial 108 for immediate medical emergency ambulance service. Grievances regarding ambulance delays can be tracked under the Health Department.

question: How can I request wheelchair ramps or tactile paving in government offices?
answer: Submit a grievance under Accessibility Department requesting barrier-free access ramps and tactile paving for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan).

question: Where can farmers get information about crop damage compensation and subsidies?
answer: Inquire about crop insurance, PM-Kisan, and seed subsidies under the Agriculture Department or contact the District Agriculture Officer.

question: How do I register a complaint regarding delayed MGNREGA wage payments?
answer: Submit your Job Card number and gram panchayat details under Rural Livelihoods Department. Wage delays are audited by the District Program Coordinator.

question: How do I report biometric failure or ration denial at Fair Price Shops?
answer: Report food grain distribution denial or dealer irregularities under Public Administration. Ration card holders can also call the toll-free PDS helpline 1967.

question: How do I apply for or correct errors in birth and death certificates?
answer: Birth and death certificate applications and corrections are processed under Public Administration at your local municipal ward office or through the state civil registration portal.

question: What happens if multiple citizens report the same civic issue?
answer: Our AI duplicate detection engine clusters similar complaints into a single ticket, boosting its priority score so authorities can resolve it faster.
